title: Chapter 651 - 651 Chance Encounter; Stop Fighting!
content:
Chapter 651 - 651 Chance Encounter; Stop Fighting!

Chapter 651 - 651 Chance Encounter; Stop Fighting!

651 Chance Encounter; Stop Fighting!

Gradually…

A very strange scene appeared at the scene.

In the dead of the night.

A large group of sleepy-looking people in pajamas stared at the fire without blinking.

Xia Xue had just swallowed a piece of meat and seemed to feel the abnormality. She could not help but slowly turn around.

The next moment, Xia Xue was stunned.

She stammered, “W-Why are you guys awake?”

The woman with her hair tied up did not answer. Instead, she asked, “Xia Xue, you are… What are you doing?”

After saying that, she could not help but swallow her saliva.

Xia Xue said, “We roasted meat?”

The woman asked again, “Is it delicious?”

“It is!” Xia Xue’s answer this time was very certain.

Everyone could not help but swallow their saliva.

Xia Xue seemed to be aware that her classmates wanted to eat the meat and were just waiting for an invitation.

However, she soon realized that the roasted meat did not belong to her.

Xia Xue turned to look at Lin Fan.

Lin Fan smiled. “There’s still a lot of roasted meat here. Everyone, sit down and eat.”

When the students heard this, their eyes lit up.

“Then we won’t stand on ceremony.”

“Thank you.”

“Thank you.”

…

All the students quickly stepped forward, cut off a piece of roasted meat, and quickly stuffed it into their mouths.

Their mouths were full of grease as they praised continuously.

“It’s so delicious!”

“It’s delicious!”

“I’ve never eaten such delicious barbecued meat before!”

…

There was no trace of pretentiousness in their tone, or rather, they were expressing their feelings as usual.

This was normal.

They had been on the road for an entire day, and there was nothing in their stomachs at all.

Lin Fan had already mastered professional cooking skills a thousand years ago.

In the past thousand years, his abilities in all aspects had been further developed.

How could it not taste good when he barbecued the meat himself?

…

In the live broadcast room…

Windcloud Loose Cultivator: [That… That looks so delicious!]

Who’s Nobler: [I want to eat it too.]

Farewell: [I can’t take it anymore! I want to get up and eat meat!]

Likes Spicy Girls: [My saliva has already flowed all over the pillow.]

…

In just a few minutes, the huge roasted meat was finished.

Class Monitor Zhang Fen said, “Lin Fan, your roast meat is so good. I think you can definitely become a star chef in the future.”

As soon as these words were said, it immediately attracted the agreement of many people.

“That’s right! You can be a star chef!”

“I heard that the salary of a star chef can be more than 50,000 World Coins per month.”

“Some powerful star chefs, especially handsome star chefs, can even host chef programs! Lin Fan is so handsome. He can definitely do it!”

“Host a show? That would be amazing!”

…

Everyone spoke one after another, and their faces gradually showed a hint of yearning and envy.

This was normal.

According to the purchasing power of today’s currency, 10,000 World Coins was about 100,000 dollars a thousand years ago.

50,000 World Coins was 500,000 yuan!

A monthly salary of 500,000! Even for a graduate of Jiangbei University, it was definitely a very high income.

They thought so, but the people in the live broadcast room did not think so at all.

…

Final: [Let Lin Fan be a star chef?]

Blazing Beauty: [50,000 World Coins? Just how much do you look down on Lin Fan?]

Dapeng: [They have no idea who they are talking to.]

…

In the blink of an eye, the next day arrived.

Sunlight shone through the cracks of the trees like stars and fell on the faces of Lin Fan, Xia Xue, Li Dongqiang, and the others.

At this moment, a gentle breeze blew over and gently brushed past everyone’s faces.

Everyone seemed to have sensed something and slowly opened their eyes.

Last night, everyone had eaten delicious food. In addition, the air in the forest was much fresher than in the city. This made everyone sleep very comfortably and contentedly. They had a good mental state.

After packing up, they set off again.

Not long after, a sound suddenly sounded in the distance.

“There seems to be something in front of us. Everyone, be careful!” The class monitor, Zhang Fen, quickly shouted in a low voice.

As soon as he said that, everyone became vigilant.

After all, this was a forbidden area.

Although it was only the outer region, there were still many dangers.

Not long after, a few figures popped their heads out.

After Zhang Song saw that they were people, he could not help but heave a sigh of relief.

Of course, he was not completely relieved.

“We are students from Class 2011 of Jiangbei University,” he said. “I’m the class monitor, Zhang Fen. The school organized an expedition into Forbidden Area No. 31. May I know who you are?”

At this moment, someone shouted from behind.

“Senior Wanhao?”

“Vice President Chen Ming?”

…

The people opposite were also observing Zhang Fen and the others.

After they heard Zhang Song’s words, their expressions became different.

Chen Ming’s eyes lit up.

It was because he saw Xia Xue!

Chen Ming smiled. “So you’re from Class 2011. We’re members of the student union. We’re here to do something according to the school’s requirements. I’m the vice president of the student union, Chen Ming.”

Immediately, the crowd was filled with discussions and praises.

“So, it’s the vice president of the student union.”

“The vice president can actually go to the forbidden area to do things. That’s great.”

“If I had known earlier, I would’ve joined the student union.”

…

Chen Ming listened to everyone’s praises and envious gazes. The corners of his mouth could not help but curl up slightly. He was very proud.

He liked this feeling very much.
